## Xi Jinping in 2024: `1B.7` expertise / institutions vs loyalists / ideologues

Best read: **I found some evidence of discipline-cleanup and technical command emphasis, but little to no evidence that Xi built independent risk-reducing expertise or institutions around nuclear decisions.** The 2024 record looks more like **tight Party control plus anti-corruption cleanup** than institutionalized, expert-led nuclear governance.

| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable page URL | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Weakly supports `1B.7` | [Book of Xi's discourses on Party discipline published](https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202405/26/content_WS66533ca6c6d0868f4e8e77c0.html) | Xinhua / english.www.gov.cn | 2024-05-26 | https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202405/26/content_WS66533ca6c6d0868f4e8e77c0.html | Xi’s discipline campaign was framed as strengthening discipline awareness and making cadres “loyal, clean and responsible.” This suggests an attempt to improve institutional discipline, but it is Party discipline, not independent risk expertise. | `1B.7`, `7B` |
| Weakly supports `1B.7` | [Xi inspects Rocket Force brigade](https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202410/19/content_WS67136968c6d0868f4e8ec184.html) | Xinhua / english.www.gov.cn | 2024-10-19 | https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202410/19/content_WS67136968c6d0868f4e8ec184.html | Xi emphasized Party absolute leadership, good command, training, and combat preparedness. This shows attention to organizational competence, but the stress is on loyalty and deterrence rather than autonomous safety expertise. | `1B.7`, `1B.3` |
| Weakly supports `1B.7` | [China's nuclear policy remains stable, consistent and predictable: spokesperson](https://eng.mod.gov.cn/xb/News_213114/NewsRelease/16341310.html) | PRC Ministry of National Defense | 2024-09-26 | https://eng.mod.gov.cn/xb/News_213114/NewsRelease/16341310.html | After the ICBM launch, the spokesperson described nuclear policy as stable, consistent, predictable, and based on no-first-use and minimum required capability. That sounds institutionally managed, but it is still a spokesperson statement, not evidence of deeper expert governance. | `1B.7`, `1B.2`, `1B.3` |
| Weakly supports `1B.7` | [Xi Jinping and the 20th Central Committee Third Plenum communique](https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202407/18/content_WS669906cdc6d0868f4e8e93db.html) | english.www.gov.cn / Xinhua | 2024-07-18 | https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202407/18/content_WS669906cdc6d0868f4e8e93db.html | The plenum reaffirmed national security and full Party self-governance. This is relevant because it shows Xi investing in centralized control structures, but not in depoliticized nuclear expertise. | `1B.7`, `7B` |
| Cuts against `1B.7` | [Li Shangfu expelled from the Party](https://www.xinhuanet.com/20240627/f929f9248c9f40bc8f9afe791c6a716f/c.html) | Xinhua | 2024-06-27 | https://www.xinhuanet.com/20240627/f929f9248c9f40bc8f9afe791c6a716f/c.html | The purge of a former defense minister reflects serious corruption inside the military elite. That undercuts any claim that Xi had already built robust risk-reducing institutions around the nuclear enterprise. | `1B.7`, `7B`, `1B.3` |
| Cuts against `1B.7` | [Reuters report on Rocket Force purges](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/military/article/3270993/chinas-communist-party-targets-another-pla-general-corruption-investigation?UUID=f0bc4b91-7818-4f96-bf67-aa5b46ac9395&next_article_id=3270939&tc=7&tpcc=enlz-globalimpact) | South China Morning Post / Reuters | 2024-07-18 | https://www.scmp.com/news/china/military/article/3270993/chinas-communist-party-targets-another-pla-general-corruption-investigation?UUID=f0bc4b91-7818-4f96-bf67-aa5b46ac9395&next_article_id=3270939&tc=7&tpcc=enlz-globalimpact | Reuters reported another Rocket Force senior officer was expelled amid a broader purge of officers overseeing China’s nuclear arsenal. That is strong evidence of a brittle, loyalty-politics-heavy system rather than a stable expert-led one. | `1B.7`, `7B`, `1B.3` |
| Cuts against `1B.7` | [China's nuclear arms control position paper](https://www.mfa.gov.cn/eng/wjb/zzjg_663340/jks_665232/kjfywj_665252/202407/t20240723_11428155.html) | PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs | 2024-06-12 | https://www.mfa.gov.cn/eng/wjb/zzjg_663340/jks_665232/kjfywj_665252/202407/t20240723_11428155.html | China called for de-escalatory arms-control language, but the paper does not show new expert institutions or verification capacity. It reads as doctrine, not institutional investment. | `1B.7`, `1B.4` |

### Synthesis

- **What supports `1B.7`:** There is some evidence of anti-corruption cleanup, discipline tightening, training emphasis, and official reassurance about nuclear policy consistency.
- **What cuts against `1B.7`:** The Rocket Force purge is the key negative fact. It suggests the nuclear enterprise was still embedded in a loyalty/corruption problem, not a mature risk-expertise system.
- **Overall judgment:** **weak support at best**. The 2024 record does **not** show Xi building independent nuclear-risk institutions; it shows **Party control, discipline campaigns, and cleanup after elite failures**.

### Search gap

I did **not** find 2024 evidence of any of the following:
- a new independent nuclear safety office or technical advisory body,
- expanded transparency or verification institutions,
- civilian expert oversight of launch/custody decisions,
- or a public move to reduce the role of loyalists / ideologues in favor of specialized risk experts.

So for `1B.7`, the evidence is **mostly absence-of-proof against** rather than positive proof for institutional investment.
